references.text: Continuation of the list of reasons for exemption from military service, including one who has planted a vineyard or become engaged
A curse that mirrors this verse: another man shall live in the house you build, as a contrast to the blessing of dedicating your own house
Nehemiah uses the term 'שֹׁטְרִים' (officers/overseers), which is also mentioned here with the same function
The theme of building houses and the Lord's blessing over the work; without the Lord, the building is in vain
Ecclesiastes speaks about building a house for oneself, a theme connected to everyday achievements and labor
Jesus' parable about excuses for not coming to the wedding feast, including one who has bought a field and one who has married - similar exemptions as in Deuteronomy
